what: a lich's thrall: a dead lesser sorcerer kept as a steward and doorkeeper, a thin, stooped walking corpse in a servant's plain robe. Its head is bare and bald, the head of a dried-out dead old man: leathery dull grey-brown skin covers all of it, with ears, a shrivelled nose, sunken cheeks, eyelids over blank white eyes and thin lips drawn back from long teeth. Its hands are the same leathery grey-brown skin, thin, with long nails. Round its neck is locked a thick black iron slave-collar as wide as its hand, and from its belt hangs a big black iron ring as wide as its head with three huge black iron keys on it. It is dead flesh, never living pink. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: leathery dull grey-brown dead skin on the head and hands alike, never orange, a plain undyed sackcloth robe of dull grey-tan, a brown rope belt, a dark iron collar, a ring of big dark iron keys, a dark iron lantern with a small pale yellow flame, blank white eyes.
wears: It wears a plain long sackcloth servant's robe with a rope belt, a thick black iron slave-collar as wide as its hand locked round its neck, plainly seen above the robe, with a short length of heavy black chain hanging from it down the chest, and at its hip one big black iron ring as wide as its head hung with three huge black iron keys, each as long as its hand. The robe has no hood and its head is bare. No jewellery.
holds: It holds exactly one iron lantern in its left hand, lifted high: a square dark iron cage as big as its head with a pale yellow candle flame inside. Its right hand is empty: a withered brown claw reaching forward. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, it shuffles forward to the left, stooped, with its weight on its front foot, the lantern lifted high in its left hand, its right arm stretched out ahead with the fingers hooked to clutch, its jaw hanging open.
must_show: a withered brown mummified face with skin on it, not a bare skull
a plain sackcloth robe, a servant, no finery
an iron collar and a ring of big keys
one iron lantern lifted in the left hand
an empty clawing right hand

what: a lich apprentice: a living mage who has gone most of the way to undeath, a tall, thin, sickly young man, painted seriously. He has a gaunt, hollow-cheeked, clean-shaven living face with a nose, ears, eyelids and lips, and skin as grey-white as candle wax, dark bruised rings round sunken eyes whose irises glow dull yellow, thin colourless lips, and long lank black hair hanging to his shoulders. Dark grey veins show on his neck and on the backs of his thin hands. He still has flesh everywhere: a wasted man, not a skeleton. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: wax grey-white skin, long black hair, dull yellow eyes, plain charcoal-grey scholar's robes with a black hem, a dull brass chain belt, a brown leather book hanging at the belt, one old yellowed ivory human skull, a sickly yellow-green flame.
wears: He wears a plain long charcoal-grey apprentice's robe with wide sleeves, a dull brass chain for a belt with one thick brown leather book hanging from it, and black shoes. The robe has no hood and his head is bare. No jewellery.
holds: He holds exactly one human skull in his left hand, low at his hip, his fingers hooked in its eye sockets: an old, plain, yellowed bone skull with no jaw; the skull is cold dead bone with no flame and no glow on it. His right hand is empty and raised high: the whole hand is wrapped in sickly yellow-green fire, on fire like the head of a burning torch, the dark fingers showing in the middle, with ragged tongues of flame rising a hand's length above the fingertips; the fire is his own bare hand burning and he holds no candle, no torch and no stick. He has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left with his weight on his front foot, his right arm raised high ahead of him with the hand itself burning in yellow-green fire, the plain skull carried low at his left hip, his head lowered and his yellow eyes fixed on the viewer, his robe and black hair swinging.
must_show: a living, gaunt young man with wax-pale skin and long black hair: his own face is flesh, not a skull
plain charcoal robes, bare head
one yellowed skull held in the left hand
the raised right hand wrapped in yellow-green fire, plainly fire and not an orb
plainer than any true lich: no crown, no regalia

what: a demi-lich: all that is left of a lich so old that its body has crumbled to dust: one single human skull, floating in the air, and nothing else, painted seriously as a grim ancient relic. The skull is real bone, very old, stained dull grey-brown like something dug out of a grave, cracked and pitted, never gold and never metal, seen three-quarters from the front, with its lower jaw dropped as far open as it will go in a wail; inside the open jaws there is only empty pitch-black darkness. A large cut gemstone is set in each eye socket, filling it completely: two big faceted emeralds that glow from inside. Its teeth have all been replaced by small cut gems, and a band of tarnished gold is inlaid flat into the bone across the brow, like a crown that has sunk into the skull. Nothing hangs beneath it.
colours: old dull grey-brown stained bone with dark brown cracks, two big glowing emerald gem eyes, small gem teeth of dull red and white, a thin tarnished gold inlaid brow band.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It hangs in empty air with nothing under it, tilted and turned a little to the left, its jaw stretched wide open wailing.
must_show: one floating human skull and nothing else
a big faceted emerald gem filling each eye socket
the jaw wide open, wailing, with gem teeth
a gold band inlaid across the brow
old cracked grey-brown bone, not gold, painted seriously

what: a skeleton lich: a bare human skeleton that still works a dead wizard's spells out of habit, with almost nothing left of its robes. Every bone is coated in pale frost, the skull, ribs, spine, arms and legs alike, and thick icicles hang from its jaw, its ribs and its elbows. Its ribcage is open and empty with dark gaps between the ribs. Its eye sockets are black and empty. Its right forearm and hand are sheathed in a jagged gauntlet of clear ice, each finger ending in a long ice-shard claw. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: frost-pale grey-white bone on every part with pale cyan ice and icicles, black empty eye sockets, a few faded dull brown rags, one dark brown clay jar with a black crack.
wears: It wears only a few tatters of a rotted dull brown robe hanging from one shoulder and from the hips. No hood, no crown, no jewellery.
holds: It holds exactly one cracked jar in its left hand, clutched against its ribs: a round dark brown clay urn as big as its skull with a wide jagged black crack down its side, empty. Its right hand is empty: the ice-sheathed claw, spread. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, it lunges to the left with its front knee bent, its ice-clawed right arm sweeping forward and up to rake, its left arm hugging the cracked jar to its ribs, its jaw open.
must_show: a bare skeleton coated in frost, the skull included, with icicles hanging from it
a jagged ice gauntlet with ice claws on the right hand
one cracked clay jar clutched in the left hand
only rags: no crown, no robes
black empty eye sockets, no fire
must_not_show: cloud of mist round the body
ice covering the whole body like a block

what: a lich lord: Koschei the Deathless of the Russian tales, a tall, gaunt, patient undead sorcerer-prince. His head is a bare ivory skull with two small steady emerald lights deep in the eye sockets, and his hands are bare bone. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a long dark crimson robe with a broad black fur collar and black fur cuffs and dull silver embroidery, a dark iron crown of tall thin spikes, emerald eye lights, one large pale gold egg, a small emerald glow at the right hand.
wears: He wears a long, heavy, dark crimson prince's coat-robe that reaches the ground, belted, with a broad black fur collar, black fur cuffs and dull silver embroidery down the front. On his skull sits a dark iron crown: a plain band with a ring of tall, thin, sharp spikes. The robe has no hood.
holds: He holds exactly one egg in his left hand, held up at chest height on his open bony palm: a large smooth pale gold egg as big as his fist. His right hand is empty: it is stretched forward with the bony fingers spread to touch, with a small emerald glow close round the fingertips. He has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left with his weight on his front foot, upright and unhurried, his right arm reaching straight out ahead to touch, his left hand holding the egg up beside his chest, his skull tilted down toward the viewer, the heavy robe swinging.
must_show: a skull face with small emerald eye lights
a dark crimson robe with a black fur collar
a dark iron crown of tall thin spikes
one pale gold egg held on the left palm
an emerald glow at the empty right hand
grander than the skeleton lich: full robes and a crown

what: a greater lich: an undead sorcerer so sure its soul is safe elsewhere that it has let its body be ruined. It is a tall human skeleton, grey and battered: its skull has a jagged black hole broken in one side of the crown and a deep crack across the brow, and several of its ribs are snapped. Three thick broken wooden spear shafts are stuck clean through its ribcage, left there for centuries, their splintered ends sticking out in front and behind. Two cold violet points of light burn in its eye sockets. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: weathered ash-grey bone with dark cracks, robes of pale bone-white and dirty ash-grey rags, a broad tarnished silver chain of office, dull brown spear shafts, violet eye lights, a ball of black fire with a bright violet rim.
wears: It wears the remains of once-fine robes bleached pale bone-white, with a tall tattered collar, hanging in long ragged strips from its shoulders and hips and open over its bare ribs, and one broad tarnished silver chain of office across its collarbones. No crown, no hood.
holds: Its right hand is empty and raised: a round ball of black fire with a bright violet rim, as big as its skull, burns in the open bony palm, touching the fingers. Its left hand is empty and hangs open at its side, holding nothing. It has no staff and no weapon in its hand.
pose: On two legs, it walks forward to the left carelessly, chest open and unguarded, with its weight on its front foot, its right hand lifted high beside its head with the black-and-violet fire in the palm, its empty left hand hanging, its cracked skull tilted, the pale rags streaming behind.
must_show: a battered grey skeleton with a hole broken in its skull
thick broken spear shafts stuck through its ribcage
the left hand empty
pale bone-white ragged robes and a silver chain
black-and-violet fire in the right palm

what: a banshee lich: an Irish banshee, the keening woman of the fairy mound, bound into a dead wizard's bones. She is a tall thin skeleton in a mourning woman's gown: her face is a bare ivory skull with the jaw stretched wide open in a scream, and her hands are bare bone. From her skull streams a great mane of long, thick, wild white hair, reaching past her waist and flying out behind her. Her eye sockets hold two pale silver-white lights, with dark streaks running down the cheekbones like tear tracks. She has the realistic proportions of a tall adult woman, about eight heads tall, with a small skull and long limbs.
colours: ivory bone, long white hair, a long dark moss-green gown, a ragged ash-grey cloak, a dull silver comb, silver-white eye lights, dark grey tear streaks.
wears: She wears a long dark moss-green gown that covers her from the neck to the ground, with long ragged sleeves, and a tattered ash-grey mourning cloak hanging from her shoulders down her back. No hood: her skull and white hair are bare.
holds: She holds exactly one large silver comb in her left hand, raised beside her hair: a broad comb as big as her hand with long thick teeth. Her right hand is empty: a bare bone hand reaching forward with the fingers spread. She has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, she glides forward to the left, leaning into it with her weight on her front foot, her skull thrust forward with the jaw wide open wailing, her right arm stretched out ahead reaching, her left hand lifted at her shoulder with the comb, her white hair and grey cloak streaming far out behind her to the right.
must_show: a skull face with the jaw wide open, wailing
a great streaming mane of long white hair
a dark green gown and a grey cloak: a woman's dress
one silver comb in the left hand
an empty bone right hand reaching

what: a lich sovereign: a dead king who still rules his court, a tall, straight-backed, regal skeleton in full coronation dress. His head is a bare ivory skull with two steady pale gold lights in the eye sockets, and his hands are bare bone. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, a long royal-purple state robe, a broad white ermine mantle with small black spots, a tall gold crown with a dark red velvet cap inside it, a gold sceptre, a great black ledger book with gold corners, pale gold eye lights.
wears: He wears a heavy royal-purple state robe that reaches the ground, and over his shoulders a wide cape-collar of white ermine fur dotted with small black spots. On his skull sits a tall closed king's crown of gold: a jewelled band with gold arches that meet at the top over a dark red velvet cap. No hood.
holds: He holds exactly one gold sceptre in his right hand: a long straight gold rod as tall as his shoulder with a round gold ball at its top, held upright at his side like a king's rod of office. Under his left arm, clamped against his ribs, he carries exactly one very large thick closed ledger book, black with gold corners. He holds nothing else: no staff, no sword.
pose: On two legs, he steps forward to the left with his weight on his front foot, his back straight and his crowned skull held high, his right arm held out to the side gripping the upright gold sceptre, the great black book clamped under his left arm, the ermine mantle and purple robe swinging.
must_show: a skull under a tall arched gold crown with a red cap
a white ermine mantle with black spots over a purple robe
one long gold sceptre with a ball top in the right hand
one big black ledger book under the left arm
the most kingly of the liches
must_not_show: ball of magic in the hand

what: an arch-lich: an undead archmage of uncounted centuries whose gaze unmakes what it looks at, a tall, gaunt skeleton that floats. Its head is a bare pale ivory skull with two very large round eye sockets, each one filled to the brim with solid bright scarlet light, like two red-hot coals, the brightest things in the picture. Fixed behind its skull stands a tall headdress of blackened iron: a flat round black disc at the back of the head, twice as wide as the skull, with eight long thick black spikes radiating from it like the points of a star, so that the pale skull stands out sharply against the black disc. Its hands are bare bone. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: ivory bone, long pitch-black robes, the black of coal and never brown, with tarnished silver rune embroidery and a silver hem band, a broad silver collar, a blackened iron spiked headdress, two big bright scarlet glowing eyes, three small round glass flasks with a pale white light inside each.
wears: It wears long pitch-black robes with wide sleeves, a panel of silver runes down the front, a silver band at the hem and a broad flat silver collar. Three small round glass flasks hang from its belt on silver chains, each with a pale white light inside: vessels of its soul. No hood.
holds: Both of its bony hands are empty: its arms are flung wide to each side with the fingers hooked. There is no magic in its hands. It has no staff, no book and no weapon.
pose: It floats just off the ground, leaning forward to the left, its black robes streaming back to the right, both arms flung wide, its skull thrust forward and its two scarlet eyes blazing at the viewer.
must_show: a skull with two blazing scarlet eyes
a black iron disc headdress with thick spikes standing behind the skull, the pale skull clear against it
pitch-black robes with silver runes, not brown
small glowing flasks hanging at the belt
both hands empty, arms spread wide

what: an ancient lich: the oldest of all liches, thousands of years dead, the last relic of a forgotten bronze-age kingdom, and the grandest of its kind. It is a tall thin skeleton whose every bone has turned dark like a fossil: the skull, the hands, the ribs and the arms alike are dark brown-black as bog oak and faintly polished, with no white or ivory bone anywhere. Two bright turquoise flames burn in its eye sockets. Long thin strands of grey cobweb hang from its jaw and from its arms. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: dark brown-black fossil bone on every part including the skull, dusty dull ochre-brown robes, the brown-gold of tarnished brass, with a dark umber border, a low horned crown and a broad collar of corroded bronze gone verdigris grey-turquoise, grey cobwebs, bright turquoise flames.
wears: It wears long, dusty dull ochre-brown robes, the brown-gold of tarnished brass, of an ancient cut, pleated and hanging in dusty folds to the ground, with a dark umber border. Over its shoulders and upper chest lies a broad flat collar made of rows of corroded verdigris bronze plates. On its skull sits a low, broad, flat-topped crown of corroded verdigris bronze, shaped like a drum, as wide as the skull and no taller than the skull's own forehead, with a row of short square teeth along its top edge, and one pair of long curved bull's horns of the same bronze sweeping out and up from its two sides. No hood.
holds: Both of its dark bony hands are empty and raised, one at each side at shoulder height, palms up: in each open palm burns a ball of bright turquoise flame as big as its skull, touching the hand. It has no staff, no book and no weapon.
pose: It floats upright just off the ground, turned a little to the left, both arms raised out to its sides with a turquoise flame in each palm, its chin lowered and its burning eyes on the viewer, its robes drifting and the cobwebs trailing.
must_show: dark brown-black bone on every part, the skull included
a low flat-topped horned crown and a broad collar of verdigris bronze
dusty dull ochre-brown robes, the brown-gold of tarnished brass,
a turquoise flame in each palm and turquoise fire in the eyes
hanging cobwebs
plainly the oldest and grandest lich

what: a gnoll pack lord: the biggest gnoll of its pack, a tall, rangy, long-limbed, stooping man-shaped creature with the head of a real spotted hyena: a broad blunt black muzzle, powerful jaws with big yellowed fangs, small round ears, and a tall stiff crest of dark brown hair down the back of the neck. It is furred like a hyena on every part that shows: its head, neck, shoulders, arms, hands, legs and feet are covered in thick, coarse, shaggy dull grey-tan fur, the colour of dry earth, with dark brown spots, and a thick shaggy ruff of the same spotted fur bursts out round its neck and over its collar; there is no bare skin anywhere on it. Its body from the collarbone to the hips is covered by a heavy studded leather coat. It has realistic proportions: a small head, long limbs.
colours: shaggy dull grey-tan fur, the colour of dry earth, with dark brown spots on head, arms and legs, a black muzzle and black lower legs, a dark brown neck crest, yellow eyes, yellowed fangs, a sleeveless coat of dark brown boiled leather with rows of dull iron studs, one dull iron shoulder plate, a necklace of big ivory fangs, a ragged dark brown hide kilt, a glaive with a dark wooden shaft and a grey steel blade.
wears: It wears a heavy sleeveless coat of dark brown boiled leather, closed down the front and covering its whole chest and belly from the throat to the hips, set with rows of dull iron studs; one dull iron plate strapped on its left shoulder; a necklace of big ivory fangs lying on the leather; a broad belt; and a ragged dark brown hide kilt to the knees. Its spotted furry arms and legs are bare of clothing. No helmet, no collar, no chains.
holds: It holds exactly one glaive in both hands: a thick dark wooden pole taller than itself, and fixed at its top one long, broad, heavy steel blade with a single curved cutting edge, shaped like the blade of a great curved cleaver, three times as broad as the pole and as long as its arm. Both furred hands grip the shaft and it holds nothing else.
pose: It lopes to the left on two legs, seen from the side and a little from the front, leaning forward with its knees bent and its weight on its front foot, both hands driving the glaive forward and upward so that the long broad curved blade is high and clear at the upper left, its jaws wide open in a snarl.
must_show: a hyena-headed gnoll with spotted sandy fur on head, arms and legs, like the gnolls of group 8
no bare skin: the chest and belly are covered by a studded dark leather coat
a fang necklace; the biggest of the pack
one glaive, a long broad curved blade on a pole, in both hands
must_not_show: spear with a small flint head

what: a wight lord: the king of the barrow-wights, the walking corpse of a Norse sea-king who will not stay in his grave and who commands the lesser dead, a very tall, gaunt, long-limbed dead man, towering and lean, never stout, plainly a corpse and plainly undead. His skin is a colour no living person has: cold pale ash-grey with a blue tinge, like a drowned man, with dark blue-grey shadows in the hollows, the same on his face, neck, arms, hands and knees. The skin is shrunk tight on the bones. His face is a dead man's: hollow cheeks, deep sunken eye sockets, a thin sharp nose, and dried grey lips drawn back from long teeth; in the sockets his two eyes are blank and white with no pupils, shining with a cold light. Long, lank, thin white hair hangs from under his helmet to his shoulders, and he has no beard. His long pale dead arms are bare from the shoulder. He has the realistic proportions of a very tall thin adult man: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold pale ash-grey dead skin with a blue tinge, lank white hair, blank white shining eyes, a dark iron helmet ringed by a crown of tarnished gold points, a sleeveless knee-length shirt of dark iron-grey mail streaked with dark rust, a long ragged black cloak, a big round gold brooch, a thick twisted gold neck ring, a broad black belt with a gold buckle, dark brown leg wrappings, a broad straight sword with a pitted dark grey iron blade and a gold hilt.
wears: On his head he wears a round dark iron helmet with a straight nose bar, and round the helmet's brow a crown is fixed: a broad band of tarnished gold with six tall plain gold points standing up from it. He wears a sleeveless knee-length shirt of dark iron mail streaked with rust that hangs loose on his thin frame, a broad black belt with a gold buckle, a long ragged black cloak hanging from both shoulders down his back, pinned with one big round gold brooch, one thick twisted gold ring round his neck, and dark brown cloth wrapped round his shins. His pale dead arms are bare.
holds: He holds exactly one sword in his right hand: an old broad straight Viking sword with a pitted dark grey iron blade as long as his leg and a short gold hilt, thrust out level in front of him toward the left, pointing the way, the blade clear of his body against the backdrop. His left hand is empty: the pale dead hand is raised beside his shoulder, open, the long fingers hooked to seize. He has no shield.
pose: On two legs, seen from the front and a little from the side, he strides forward to the left, dragging his twisted back foot behind him, his weight on his bent front leg, his right arm thrust straight out to the left pointing his sword in command, his left hand raised and clawing, his head high, his jaw open bellowing an order, his black cloak swinging out behind to the right.
must_show: plainly dead: cold pale ash-grey skin on face and bare arms alike, blank white eyes, lips shrunk from the teeth, like the wights of group 16
a dark iron helmet ringed by a gold crown of points
one broad sword in the right hand, pointing; the left hand empty and clawing
a rusted mail shirt, a ragged black cloak, a gold neck ring
a tall gaunt lord, more richly geared than any plain wight

what: a necromancer lord: a sorcerer in the mould of Koschei the Deathless, a tall, starved, very old man who is more dead than alive, painted seriously. He has a long narrow face of grey-white skin like old wax, with hollow cheeks, a hooked nose, deep-set eyes glowing pale violet, a bald crown with long thin grey hair at the sides, and a very long, thin, straggling grey beard that hangs down to his belt. His hands are thin and grey with long nails. He has skin on his face: a withered man, not a skull. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: wax grey-white skin, a long grey beard and grey hair, long black robes with a dark wine-red sash, a mantle of big rib bones and a bone staff topped with a horned ram skull, all the bone a dull pale grey-white like chalk, never yellow and never gold, pale violet eye glow.
wears: He wears long black robes with a dark wine-red sash at the waist, and over his shoulders a mantle made of a dozen big curved dull grey-white rib bones with dark gaps between them, standing up behind his shoulders and neck like the bars of a cage. No hood and no hat: his head is bare.
holds: He holds exactly one staff in his right hand, gripped at its middle and held upright: a thick straight staff built of big dull grey-white spine bones, as tall as he is, topped with exactly one ram's skull with two big curled horns and a pale violet light in its eye sockets. His left hand is empty: a withered grey hand stretched forward with the fingers hooked to clutch. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he advances to the left, leaning forward with his weight on his front foot, the bone staff held upright out ahead of him in his right hand, his left hand reaching forward and clawing the air, his long beard and black robes swinging.
must_show: a gaunt old man with a very long grey beard and flesh on his face, not a skull
black robes with a mantle of big rib bones on the shoulders
one bone staff topped with a horned ram skull, in the right hand
pale violet glow in his eyes and the ram skull's
an empty left hand reaching
must_not_show: ram's head on his own shoulders

what: an imp lord: a small, lean, sinewy old devil who has made himself a minor noble of hell, painted seriously, sly and vain, never cute. He has dull brick-red leathery skin on the face, hands, legs and tail alike, a narrow wrinkled face with a long pointed chin and a small black pointed goatee, a hooked nose, slanted yellow eyes, long pointed ears, a thin sneer of small sharp teeth, and two short curved black horns. He has a pair of dark leathery bat wings, thin wiry limbs, clawed feet, and one thick tail of round segments that ends in a swollen black bulb with one curved needle-point. He is small but fully grown: a small head and a lean, knotted body.
colours: dull brick-red skin, dark maroon wing membranes with black ribs, black horns and goatee, yellow eyes, a black velvet doublet with tarnished gold buttons, a wide white pleated ruff collar, a short dark crimson half-cape, dark brown breeches, a black iron rapier.
wears: He wears the court dress of a petty noble: a fitted black velvet doublet with gold buttons, a wide white pleated ruff round his neck, a short dark crimson cape over his left shoulder, and dark breeches. His horned head is bare.
holds: He holds exactly one rapier in his right hand: a straight, narrow black iron blade as long as his arm, drawn boldly, with a round black cup guard at the hilt. His left hand is empty: it is raised high behind him with two clawed fingers lifted in a summoning gesture. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, in a fencer's lunge to the left: his front knee bent and his rear leg straight, his right arm fully extended with the rapier pointing straight to the left, his empty left hand raised high behind him, his wings lifted behind his back, his tail curled up behind, his chin lifted in a sneer.
must_show: a small lean brick-red devil with short horns, bat wings and a stinging tail
court dress: a black doublet with gold buttons and a wide white ruff
one black rapier in the right hand, in a fencer's lunge
the left hand empty and raised
a sly wrinkled painted face, not a cute one

what: a spectral lord: the ghost of a warlord, a tall, gaunt, long-limbed figure made entirely of pale light in the shape of a knight in full plate armour; he is plainly wearing armour everywhere: big round shoulder plates, a breastplate with a ridge down its middle, a skirt of armour plates over the hips and jointed leg armour, and nowhere is there a bare body. Every part of him, the armour, the helm, the cape and the gauntlets alike, is the same pale bone-white ghost-light with a faint grey-green tint, nearly white, with dark grey-teal lines in the hollows and between the plates so that every armour plate reads clearly, drawn solid enough to read clearly. His head is a closed helm with a narrow visor slit in which two bright white eyes burn, and a crown of tall spikes rises from the top of the helm as one piece with it. He has broad shoulder plates, a breastplate and gauntlets, and a long tattered cape. His legs are armoured in the same pale light, and the long cape behind him frays away into ragged trailing wisps of it.
colours: pale bone-white ghost-light with a faint grey-green tint, nearly white, on every part, the armour, helm, crown and cape alike, with dark grey-teal shadows in the hollows and joints between the plates, and two bright white eye points.
wears: He wears the ghost of his plate armour, a crowned closed helm and a tattered cape, all made of the same pale light as the rest of him.
holds: Both of his ghostly gauntlets are empty and he holds nothing: his right arm reaches forward with the open hand spread to draw the life out of its prey, and his left hand is a clenched fist drawn back. He has no sword and no shield.
pose: He swoops forward to the left through empty air, leaning into it, his right arm stretched out ahead with the fingers spread, his left fist drawn back, his feet off the ground, his cape and its wisps streaming away to the right.
must_show: a ghost in the shape of an armoured knight, all of one pale bone-white light with a faint grey-green tint
a crowned closed helm with two white eye points
a tattered ghostly cape
the cape fraying into trailing wisps
empty hands, the right reaching
armoured and crowned, unlike a hooded wraith
must_not_show: cloud of mist hiding the body

what: a vampire lord: a vampire prince of the old Wallachian kind, tall, lean, straight-backed and courteous, hard and cruel underneath. His skin is corpse-pale grey-white, dead flesh, never living pink, on his face and hands alike. He has a long narrow face with high cheekbones, a strong hooked nose, a long black moustache, heavy black brows, deep-set red eyes, and a mouth open in a cold smile that shows two long white fangs. His thick black hair falls to his shoulders. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: corpse-pale grey-white skin, long black hair and a black moustache, red eyes, a long black velvet coat with silver clasps, a long black cape with a bright scarlet lining, a round dark red velvet cap with a band of white pearls, black boots, a silver goblet.
wears: He wears a long black velvet coat fastened down the front with silver clasps, tall black boots, a long black cape with a bright scarlet lining and a tall collar, and on his head a round dark red velvet prince's cap with a broad band of white pearls and one gold star-shaped jewel at the front.
holds: He holds exactly one silver goblet in his left hand, lifted as in a toast: a wide silver cup on a stem, as big as his fist. His right hand is empty: the arm is stretched forward with the palm up and the long pale fingers beckoning. He holds nothing else: no sword.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left with his weight on his front foot, his right arm extended beckoning the viewer in, the goblet lifted in his left hand at shoulder height, his cape swept open wide so the scarlet lining shows, his chin lowered and his red eyes fixed on the viewer, fangs showing.
must_show: a corpse-pale nobleman with long black hair, a black moustache, red eyes and fangs
a black cape with a scarlet lining
a dark red cap with a pearl band
one silver goblet lifted in the left hand
the empty right hand beckoning
a courteous prince, not a snarling beast

what: a death knight lord: a dead commander who broke his oath, a tall, broad-shouldered skeleton in a full suit of black parade armour kept in perfect order. His head is a bare ivory skull, plainly seen inside an open-faced helmet, with two cold pale cyan points of light in the eye sockets; there is no skin on him anywhere. It has the realistic anatomy and proportions of a tall adult man: a small skull, a long neck and spine, a narrow ribcage, long thin arms and legs, and it stands about eight heads tall.
colours: an ivory skull, polished black steel plate armour with tarnished gold edges, a tall black horsehair plume, a broad dark ink-blue officer's sash, a long tattered black cape, a greatsword with a pale cyan-white glowing blade and a gold crossguard, pale cyan eye lights.
wears: He wears a full suit of polished black steel plate armour from neck to foot, every plate edged with tarnished gold, an open-faced black helmet with a gold brow band and one tall black horsehair plume standing straight up from its top, a broad dark ink-blue officer's sash running diagonally across the breastplate from the right shoulder to the left hip, and a long tattered black cape.
holds: He holds exactly one greatsword in his right hand: a long, broad, straight blade as long as his own body, glowing pale cyan-white from the hilt to the tip, with a gold crossguard. His left hand is empty: an open gauntlet held ready at his side. He has no shield and holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he advances to the left in an exact drill-book guard, his weight on his front foot and his knees bent, the greatsword held out low in his right hand with the long glowing blade slanting forward and down to the lower left, his skull lowered behind it, his cape swinging.
must_show: a bare skull face in an open-faced helmet
black plate armour with gold edges and a diagonal officer's sash
a tall black plume on the helmet
one pale glowing greatsword in the right hand, the left hand empty
a long black cape
higher in rank than a plain death knight: skull shown, gold trim, plume and sash

what: an ancient vampire lord: the strix of the old Roman night, older than the word vampire, a tall, gaunt, terrible night-creature who was once a nobleman of the ancient world. His skin is dead flesh, never living pink and never tan: a cold pale grey-white like chalk and ash, with dark grey shadows, on his head, arms and hands alike. His head is hairless and long-skulled, with two huge pointed ears, deep-sunk eyes glowing amber-yellow, sunken cheeks, and a wide mouth of many long ivory fangs. Each of his long fingers ends in a long curved black claw. From his back spread two huge black bat wings with torn edges. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: cold chalk-pale grey-white dead skin, never tan, black wing membranes with dark grey ribs, amber-yellow eyes, ivory fangs, black claws, a dark wine-red draped robe with a tarnished gold border, a wreath of tarnished gold leaves, gold arm bands, brown sandals.
wears: He wears the dress of ancient Rome: a long dark wine-red robe draped over his left shoulder and wrapped round his body, covering his chest and reaching to his ankles, with a tarnished gold border; a wreath of tarnished gold leaves on his bald head; a gold band on each forearm; and sandals.
holds: Both of his clawed hands are empty and he holds nothing: his right hand is raised high with the long black claws spread to rake, and his left hand reaches forward low.
pose: On two legs, standing tall at his full height, he strides forward to the left with his weight on his front foot and his legs nearly straight, both huge bat wings spread wide behind him, his right claw raised high to rake down, his left claw reaching forward, his fanged mouth open.
must_show: a gaunt chalk-grey hairless vampire with huge pointed ears and many fangs
two huge black bat wings spread behind him
a draped dark wine-red ancient robe with a gold border
a wreath of gold leaves on the bald head
long black claws, both hands empty

what: a death lord: a rider in the train of Death from the Book of Revelation, one horse and one rider. The horse is starving, as thin as a greyhound: a walking carcass of a horse on four legs, corpse-grey as cold ash, every rib showing as a dark stripe along its sunken flank, its hip bones and spine jutting, its belly hollow, its legs like sticks with knobbly joints, with a long bony head like a skull with sunken cheeks and blank white eyes, a thin drooping neck, and only a few thin ragged strands of grey mane and tail. The rider sits upright in the saddle: a tall dead conqueror, a skeleton in ancient armour. His head is a bare ivory skull with two white lights in the eye sockets, under a dark bronze helmet with a tall black horsehair crest running front to back. His hands are bare bone.
colours: a starved corpse-grey horse the colour of cold ash with dark grey hollows between its ribs, a few strands of grey mane and tail, an ivory skull, a dark bronze helmet with a black horsehair crest, dark bronze scale armour, a long ragged black cloak, black saddle and reins, white eye lights.
wears: The rider wears a coat of dark bronze scale armour, a dark bronze helmet with a tall black horsehair crest, and a long ragged black cloak that hangs from his shoulders over the horse's rump. The horse wears a plain black saddle and bridle.
holds: The rider's right hand is empty: his right arm is stretched straight out ahead over the horse's neck with one bony finger pointing forward to the left. His left hand holds the black reins at the horse's neck. He holds nothing else: no weapon.
pose: Seen in full profile from the side like a figure on a coin, facing left: the pale horse strides forward on four legs with one front leg lifted high and its thin neck stretched low and its bony head hanging; the rider sits upright with his right arm stretched straight out pointing to the left, his skull turned to the left, his black cloak streaming behind to the right.
must_show: one starved corpse-grey horse on four legs with every rib showing, seen from the side
one skeleton rider with a bare skull under a crested bronze helmet
dark bronze scale armour and a long black cloak
the rider's right arm stretched out pointing, no weapon

what: an infernal lord: a baron of hell, a tall, broad, powerful devil who stands upright like a man and does not hurry. He has dark crimson skin on his face and neck, a long cruel face with a black pointed beard, burning yellow eyes and fangs, and two great ridged black horns that sweep back from his brow and curl round beside his ears. Two big black bat wings rise behind his shoulders. He has the realistic proportions of a tall heavy warrior, about eight heads tall, with a small head.
colours: dark crimson skin, black horns and beard, yellow eyes, black wings with dark red membranes, black plate armour with bright brass-gold trim, a heavy gold chain with a round gold medallion, a greatsword with a dark iron blade veined and edged with glowing red-orange fire.
wears: He wears a full suit of ornate black plate armour from the neck to the feet, every plate edged with brass-gold trim, and across the breastplate a heavy gold chain of office with one round gold signet medallion. His horned head is bare: no helmet.
holds: He holds exactly one greatsword in his right hand, point down at his side: a long, broad, dark iron blade as long as his own body, glowing red-orange along its edges and in cracks down its length like iron fresh from the forge, with a gold crossguard. His left hand is an empty clenched gauntlet. He holds nothing else.
pose: On two legs, he strides slowly forward to the left with his weight on his front foot, the glowing greatsword held low in his right hand with the blade slanting down to the lower left, his wings raised behind his shoulders, his chin lifted in contempt.
must_show: a dark crimson devil lord with great curled black horns and a black beard
ornate black plate armour with gold trim and a gold chain of office
two black bat wings
one greatsword glowing red-orange with hellfire, in the right hand
the most ornate and imposing of the lords
must_not_show: ball of fire in the hand

what: the Nemean Lion of the Greek myth, the first labour of Hercules: a real male lion, a real animal on four legs, enormous, deep-chested and heavily muscled, with a huge thick mane round its head, neck and chest, a broad scarred muzzle, small round ears, long ivory fangs and long ivory claws. Its hide cannot be cut: its short fur is pale tawny straw-gold over the whole body with a dull metallic sheen, with pale highlights along the back, shoulders and flanks as if the hide were hammered metal. The mane is very dark brown, nearly black, and runs on under the chest and belly.
colours: pale tawny straw-gold fur over the whole body with a dull metallic sheen and pale highlights, a very dark brown mane that is nearly black, amber eyes, a dark brown nose, ivory fangs and claws, a black tail tuft.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, on four legs: it lunges forward with its front legs braced and its claws out, its hind legs driving behind, its body horizontal, its huge maned head low and thrust forward with the jaws wide open roaring, its tail lashing behind.
must_show: a huge male lion on four legs with a great dark, nearly black mane
a hide of pale tawny gold with a dull metallic sheen, not orange
jaws open roaring, long fangs and claws
a mythic beast, plainly grander than an ordinary lion

what: a lizardfolk hunter: a tall, lean, long-limbed scaled marsh-dweller that stands upright on two legs, as tall as a man. It has the head of a real monitor lizard: a long flat snout, a wide mouth of small sharp teeth, small cold yellow eyes with slit pupils, and a low ridge of short spines from its brow down the back of its neck. Its whole body is covered in scales: chest, belly, arms and legs, and it has one long, thick, heavy tail. Its hands and its three-toed feet are clawed. It has a small head and long limbs.
colours: dull olive-green scales with darker brown-olive bands on the back and tail, a pale yellow-tan belly and throat, yellow eyes, a brown hide loincloth, a necklace of small white bones and teeth, a dark brown wooden club.
wears: It wears only a ragged brown hide loincloth and a cord necklace of small bones and teeth. No armour.
holds: It holds exactly one club in its right hand, raised: one straight length of dark wood as long as its arm, narrow at the grip and swelling to a knobbly end, with nothing fixed to it. Its left hand is empty: a clawed hand held out in front.
pose: On two legs, it stalks forward to the left, leaning forward with its weight on its front foot, the club raised high and back in its right hand, its empty left claw reaching ahead, its mouth open hissing, its heavy tail swung out behind for balance.
must_show: a tall upright lizard-man with a long flat snout and a thick tail
dull olive scales with a pale belly
only a loincloth: no armour
one plain wooden club in the right hand
man-sized and lean, far bigger than a kobold

what: a locust swarmlord: a captain of the locusts of the bottomless pit, from the Book of Revelation: a giant locust as big as a war-horse. It has a real locust's body, long and horizontal: a long segmented abdomen, jointed insect walking legs, the two big folded jumping legs at the back, and long narrow wings folded shut, lying closed along its back like a furled umbrella. In place of an insect head it has a man's stern face with long flowing black hair, a forked black beard and a wide-open mouth of long lion's fangs. Its two front limbs are not legs: each one is a single great curved blade of dark chitin, shaped like a crescent moon, as long as its own body is deep, raised in front of it. Its abdomen ends in a curled scorpion's tail: a swollen black bulb with one curved needle-point.
colours: dull olive-brown locust shell with a paler tan underside, a tall gold crown, long black hair and beard, a pale grey-tan human face, smoky amber-grey wings folded along the back, two dark brown scythe limbs with broad pale bone-coloured cutting edges, a black sting.
wears: It wears only a tall gold crown with long points on its head.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing: its two front limbs are themselves the great curved chitin blades.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its long body is horizontal on its insect legs with the front end lifted, its two great scythe limbs raised in front of its chest, one a little higher than the other, curving forward and down to the left, its wings folded shut along its back, its scorpion tail arched high over its body, its fanged mouth wide open bellowing.
must_show: a giant locust's body with insect legs and wings, horizontal
a man's crowned, bearded face with a fanged mouth, in place of an insect head
two great curved chitin scythe limbs raised in front
a scorpion's tail arched over the back
a tall gold crown: a captain
must_not_show: man standing upright on two legs

what: a battle mage: a lean, hard, wiry living man in his thirties with weather-beaten light tan skin, a shaved head, a short dark beard and a grim squinting face. Both of his arms are bare from the shoulder, and both arms are covered from the shoulder to the knuckles in bold black tattooed bands and lines, like channels drawn down the arm. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: weather-beaten light tan skin, bold black tattoo lines on the arms only, a sleeveless dark brown quilted leather jerkin, dull grey-tan trousers, brown boots, a dull red cloth sash, an orange and yellow flame, a cluster of pale cyan-white ice.
wears: He wears a sleeveless dark brown quilted leather jerkin, dull grey-tan trousers, brown boots, a dull red cloth sash at the waist and one leather strap with pouches across his chest. No robe, no hat, no hood and no armour.
holds: His hands are empty of any weapon and he holds nothing. In his right palm burns a round ball of orange flame as big as his fist, touching the hand. In his left palm sits a jagged cluster of pale cyan-white ice shards as big as his fist, touching the hand. He has no staff.
pose: On two legs, he lunges to the left with his front knee bent, his right arm thrust straight out ahead with the ball of fire in its palm, his left arm cocked back at his shoulder with the ice ready to throw, his teeth gritted.
must_show: a living human man with a shaved head and a short dark beard
bare arms covered in bold black tattoo bands
a sleeveless leather jerkin: no robe
a ball of orange fire in the right palm
a cluster of pale ice in the left palm

what: a drow mage: a dark elf man, tall, slender and cold-faced, with dark charcoal-grey skin on his face and hands alike, long pointed ears, pale red eyes, a clean-shaven narrow face, and long straight white hair tied back in a tail. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dark charcoal-grey skin, long white hair, pale red eyes, a long dark indigo robe with silver trim, a short black shoulder cape, a silver belt, black boots, a black book with silver corners and silver page edges, a ball of pale lilac flame.
wears: He wears a long, high-collared dark indigo robe that reaches his ankles, edged with silver trim, a short black cape over his shoulders, a silver belt and black boots. No hood and no hat: his head is bare.
holds: He holds exactly one book in his left hand, held open against his chest: a thick black book with silver corners and silver-edged pages. His right hand is empty: a round ball of pale lilac flame as big as his fist burns in the open palm, touching the hand. He has no staff and no weapon.
pose: On two legs, he strides forward to the left with his weight on his front foot and his body turned, his right arm thrust out ahead with the lilac flame in its palm, the open black book held to his chest in his left hand, his chin lifted, his white hair and indigo robe swinging.
must_show: a dark elf man: charcoal-grey skin, long pointed ears, long white hair
a dark indigo robe with silver trim, bare head
one open black-and-silver book in the left hand
a ball of pale lilac flame in the right palm

what: a mage-slayer assassin: a lean, hard, athletic human killer trained to hunt wizards. His hood is up, and the lower half of his face is covered by a black cloth mask up to the bridge of the nose, so that only two narrow cold grey eyes and a strip of pale skin show. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: a long charcoal-grey hooded coat whose inside lining is dark oxblood-red cloth stitched with rows of black sigils, a black face mask, dark grey trousers, black boots, black leather gloves, a short sword with a bright steel blade and a black grip, three snapped pale wooden wands at the belt, pale skin round the eyes.
wears: He wears a long charcoal-grey hooded coat that reaches his knees, hanging open and flaring out so that its dark oxblood-red lining, stitched with rows of black ward-sigils, shows on both sides; a black cloth mask over his nose and mouth; black leather gloves; dark grey trousers and black boots. Three snapped wooden wizard's wands are tied at his belt as trophies.
holds: He holds exactly one short sword in his right fist: a broad, plain, straight steel blade as long as his forearm, held level at waist height and pointing to the left, its hilt in his right fist. His left hand is empty and open, held up ahead at head height with the black-gloved fingers spread, nothing in it. He holds no second blade, no knife and no dagger.
pose: On two legs, he lunges low to the left with his front knee deeply bent and his rear leg stretched out behind, his sword arm thrust forward at waist height, his empty left hand reaching ahead above it, his coat flaring wide behind him so the dark oxblood-red lining shows.
must_show: a hooded, masked human in a long charcoal-grey coat
the coat's dark oxblood-red lining with black sigils showing
one short straight sword in the right hand
an empty gloved left hand reaching
no magic: a killer, not a caster
